description: Canonical AgentTel semantic attribute schema. Single source of truth for all agenttel.* and gen_ai.* attribute keys and event names across the JVM, Go, Node.js and Python SDKs. Field meanings: docs/reference/attribute-schema.md

agenttel.topology.description: Service ownership, tier, and dependency graph metadata

upstream.note: May overlap a future OTel service owner attribute

dependencies.description: JSON array of dependency descriptors (name, type, criticality, protocol, timeout_ms, circuit_breaker, fallback, health_endpoint)

upstream.note: JSON-encoded string; flat attributes or entity relationships may suit OTel better

consumers.description: JSON array of consumer descriptors (name, consumption_pattern, sla_latency_ms)

upstream.note: JSON-encoded string; flat attributes or entity relationships may suit OTel better

agenttel.baseline.description: Expected operational norms for anomaly detection

upstream.note: Declared in config (source=static) or computed by the engine (source=rolling). Only the declared form is in the first proposal

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last baseline update

upstream.note: Duplicates agenttel.slo.name

sample_count.description: Number of samples used to compute baseline

confidence.description: Confidence in the baseline, from sample count
